up: Return the exact activity values and canonical SMILES for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649961.
sql:
SELECT
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE a.assay_id = (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649961');
